description: Trim any audio file into a ringtone with fade in/out — preview it, then download as WAV or MP3.

faqs.a: Set start/end times and fade lengths, then preview before downloading. Fades are linear volume ramps applied to the real audio data.
faqs.q: How do trimming and fades work?

faqs.a: WAV always works (built into your browser). MP3 needs the encoder library to load from the CDN — if it fails you'll get an honest message.
faqs.q: WAV or MP3 — which should I pick?

faqs.a: Yes — decoding, trimming and encoding all happen locally in your browser.

howto: Drag the start/end sliders to the section you want.
Preview, then download as WAV or MP3.
title: Ringtone Maker
